headline: Beijing opens a call for scientific data centers to support AI-enabled research
summary: Beijing opened a call for proposals to build domain scientific data centers for AI-enabled research. The notice and its construction requirements specify data aggregation and governance, AI-Ready preprocessing and annotation pipelines, multimodal processing, research-trajectory datasets, audited access controls, and connection to the municipal open-science-data platform with API and integrated-compute services. Projects may last up to three years; company applicants must provide matching funds at a minimum 2:1 ratio to municipal science funding. Applications are due October 28, 2026. The call establishes requirements, not awards, operating centers or delivered research-data access.
